🛡️ Sentinel: [HIGH] Fix XSS vulnerabilities in string interpolation (#126)

* fix: wrap untrusted num fields with escapeHtml in dojoToday main.ts

In `engines/dojoToday/src/main.ts`, the `a.num` and `n.num` fields from the snapshot data were interpolated directly into the HTML string assigned to `innerHTML` without sanitization. This commit mitigates the XSS vulnerability by applying the `escapeHtml` utility to those properties before rendering.

⚡ Bolt: [performance improvement] fast path in escapeHtml (#127)

* ⚡ Bolt: [performance improvement] fast path in escapeHtml

Implement a RegExp.test() fast-path inside engines/dojoToday's escapeHtml function.
Because the overwhelming majority of interpolated values do not contain special HTML characters, checking for their presence before invoking String.replace() avoids unnecessary regex allocation and garbage collection overhead in this vanilla string-templated environment.

⚡ Bolt: [performance improvement] Implement RegExp fast-path for escapeHtml in dojoToday (#124)

* perf(dojoToday): implement RegExp fast path for escapeHtml

Added a `RegExp.test()` fast-path to the `escapeHtml` utility and hoisted
regex definitions. This avoids unnecessary regex object allocations and garbage
collection overhead on strings that don't contain any escapable characters,
which significantly improves string template rendering performance.

ci: skip pixelDojo games matrix job when no games exist (#120)

An empty matrix fails the job at evaluation time ('Matrix vector does not
contain any values') instead of skipping it, and the failure never appears
in the jobs list — it only marks the whole run as failed. This has made
every main run report 'failure' despite all 33 visible jobs being green.

Gate the job on the discover output so the no-games case is a clean skip,
matching the intent documented in the comment above the job.
ci: trigger fresh run (previous run record stuck on stale conclusion after rerun)

ci: fix main red — voxelDojo biome lint + literacyDojo lockfile (#119)

* ci: fix main red — biome organizeImports in voxelDojo games, literacyDojo lockfile sync

- voxelDojo: apply biome safe fix (organizeImports) to game-*/src/evidence/emit.ts
  in all 16 game packages; the catalog lint job failed on these.
- literacyDojo: regenerate package-lock.json so @types/node matches
  package.json (^22.10.0); npm ci failed with EUSAGE on the stale lock.

* ci(voxelDojo): drop --config-path=.. from per-game lint scripts

Biome 2.x resolves CLI paths relative to the config file's directory when
--config-path is given, so 'src playwright' were ignored and the per-game CI
matrix jobs failed with 'No files were processed'. Without the flag, biome
auto-discovers the workspace root biome.jsonc from each game directory.

Verified locally: pnpm --filter "game-*" lint (16/16 green).
